# SNMPv3 harness REPORT fixtures

These complete SNMPv3 messages were generated by libsnmp 5.9.4.pre2 (Debian package net-snmp `5.9.4+dfsg-2+deb13u1`) through the optional generator in `netsnmp/v3_report_netsnmp.go`:

```sh
cd netsnmp
go test -tags netsnmp -run '^TestV3ReportFixtures$' -rec=true -count=1
```

Normal tests replay the committed base64 files and do not require libsnmp, cgo, or external commands.

Both fixtures use engine ID `80001f88046861726e657373`, engine boots `7`, engine time `424242`, an empty context name, zero error status/index, and one Counter32 varbind with value `1`.

| File | msgID | request-id | Security | User | OID | Decoded SHA-256 |
|---|---:|---:|---|---|---|---|
| `unknown_engine_ids_report.b64` | 170000001 | 270000001 | noAuthNoPriv | empty | `1.3.6.1.6.3.15.1.1.4.0` | `571335cf27436036bcc4c63b53c80be663aabffbf18df73e8f347cf913e1414d` |
| `not_in_time_windows_report_sha1.b64` | 170000101 | 270000101 | authNoPriv, HMAC-SHA-96 | `harnessUser` / test passphrase `harnessAuthKey1` | `1.3.6.1.6.3.15.1.1.2.0` | `918ab4c85b72bbb6098ad5cb8785117d610af347bbc70b2920774fc670ef75da` |

The authenticated fixture's localized SHA-1 key is `47df9195cd6ac751ed9a2b4ba3025e75a605a227`. Independently recomputing HMAC-SHA-96 with the authentication field zeroed gives the committed field `b6c19348934db5b8a57c6435`.
